rows.text: For the full-year 2026, Trimble expects to report revenue between $3,900 million and $3,950 million, GAAP loss per share of $0.07 to $0.12, and non-GAAP earnings per share of $3.60 to $3.70.
For the third quarter of 2026, Trimble expects to report revenue between $953 million and $978 million, GAAP earnings per share of $0.39 to $0.44, and non-GAAP earnings per share of $0.83 to $0.88.
